params.text: Student Learning and Activity Center (SLAC, 学生学习与活动中心) is a place where students can study and participate in various activities. It has the WKU Library and a 24-hour self-study room.
The third floor of Wenzhou-Kean University Library offers a quiet study space with extensive academic resources and comfortable seating for students. Students can discuss their projects here.
When you enter from the southern gate of SLAC, you can see the large 'Student Learning & Activity Center' logo.
The library offers a diverse collection of books across various disciplines, including textbooks, research materials, and literature, with borrowing services available with their ID cards.

params.text: The Student One-Stop Service Center (学生一站式服务中心) is located on the B1 floor. It offers assistance with student ID issuance (学生证办理) and other essential services, such as face recognition (人脸识别) for entrance access.
Let's explore!

The General Education Hall (GEH, 通识教学楼) of Wenzhou-Kean University serves as the main building for general studies courses, the building offers students a variety of learning spaces, including classrooms, bookstore, English Language Center, Language Lounge, Writing Center, and etc., creating an efficient learning environment.

The Writing Center has many student tutors.

params.text: The English Language Center (ELC, 英语语言中心) at Wenzhou-Kean University is a teaching and support facility dedicated to improving students' English language skills. ELC is committed to helping students use English with confidence in their academic and professional language learning. Students can book an appointment with the staff of ELC to improve their English proficiency.

The bookstore (书店) is located on the ground floor of GEH. It offers a wide range of creative products, including notebooks, pens, canvas bags, clothing, power banks, postcards, and teddy bears with the WKU logo. Sometimes, students can enjoy discounts.

The College of Business and Public Management (CBPM, 商院) is located on the west side of the central campus. It mainly provides classrooms for students majoring in Finance, Marketing, Management Science, and related fields.

Bloomberg (彭博实验室) terminal is a data terminal system developed by the financial information service provider Bloomberg. It is an important tool for people in the financial industry to obtain data and information, conduct market analysis and trading. It provides real-time market conditions, historical data, prices and trading information of the global market, with wide information sources and fast access speed, and can quickly respond to the needs of teachers and students to consult and download research data.

The Gehekai Hall (GHK, 葛和凯楼) is located at the center of the WKU campus. It houses (容纳) students from the Computer Science and Architecture programs. By the way, be sure to try the Starbucks coffee while you are here.

scenes.scenedescription: As the "city living room" of the whole campus, the atrium is open to all teachers and students. The sightseeing elevator and hanging stairs provide convenient access to classrooms and activity areas. The three-story wide steps not only assist the daily passing of a large number of people, but also serve as an open "multi-functional hall" for public lectures of colleges, which can accommodate up to 800 people.

params.text: As the “city living room” (城市客厅) of the campus, the atrium (中庭) is open to all teachers and students. The sightseeing elevator and hanging stairs provide convenient access to classrooms and activity areas. The three-story wide steps not only support high daily foot traffic (人流量) but also function as an open, multi-purpose hall for college lectures, accommodating up to 800 people.
The GHK Canteen has Starbucks coffee shop there
GHK Library is in the 2nd floor.
Classroom is located in 1st floor, mainly for computer majors.
Flexible architectural and design workshops occupy the main spaces on the fourth and fifth floors, which are consisted of north-facing angled long spaces that surround the central atrium (中央大厅).

The College of Science, Mathematics, and Technology (CSMT, 理工学院) Building sits at the heart of the WKU campus, next to GHK. While blending with nearby academic buildings, its design reflects CSMT’s core values of innovation (创新), rationality (理性), and simplicity (简约). Students here study biology, physics, chemistry, and environmental sciences.

params.text: As you approach the building, three striking words come into view: 'Innovate' (创新), 'Discover' (发现), and 'Inspire' (启迪). These are not only the motto of CSMT, but also serve as guiding principles for the actions of every student and faculty member.

On the west side lies a vibrant public area that includes spaces for academic activities, reading, and student events—providing a well-rounded environment where you can learn while enjoying the beautiful campus views.
On the east side is a quiet laboratory zone, featuring specialized labs, shared classrooms, offices, and lounge areas—all designed to provide an ideal environment for academic research.

The 1st floor houses a spacious academic lecture hall, international-style roundtable conference rooms, and dozens of modern classrooms, making it an ideal venue for academic lectures, seminars, and teaching activities. Its advanced multimedia facilities greatly enhance the exchange and dissemination of knowledge between faculty and students.

This area serves as the primary hub for biological research, featuring laboratories dedicated to major fields such as bioinformatics, cell and molecular biology, plant science, and animal biology. It is also equipped with a standardized cell culture room and a core equipment platform, meeting the comprehensive needs of scientific research. The advanced laboratory environment and convenient research facilities provide strong support for faculty, students, and researchers alike.

The Writing Center (写作中心) is located on the 2nd floor of GEH A Building and is staffed (配备) by English professors. These professors provide guidance on how to revise students' essays in terms of vocabulary, grammar, and structure.

The English Language Center (ELC, 英语语言中心) is located on the 3rd floor of GEH B building. Teachers at the ELC provide one-to-one language tutoring, such as speech and presentation practice, listening exercises, MLA/APA formatting, and more. However, teachers at the ELC are not allowed to make direct adjustments to students’ assignments.

The English Language Lab (ELL, 英语语言实验室) is located on the 4th floor of GEH B Building. It offers opportunities for students to evaluate, practice, and enhance their English language proficiency through computer systems.

Please DO NOT enter the Counseling Center (sessions may be in progress). Take photos only from outside.

The Wenzhou-Kean Suntree Counseling Center (温州肯恩太阳树心理中心) is located on the 4th floor of the GEH D Building. It provides individual psychological assessments and counseling (心理咨询), group counseling, and support for mental health issues.
The Language Lounge (语言活动室) is located on the 5th floor of GEH B Building. It serves as a meeting place where professors hold various activities, such as mini-conferences, lectures, and workshops.
Wooden Stairs (商学院大楼梯) are located on the 1st floor of CBPM. They are a notable and beautiful spot on campus.
Farahi Garden (法拉希花园) is located on the rooftop of CBPM. It is a nice place for students to relax and enjoy the campus scenery.
Subway (赛百味) is located on the 1st floor of CBPM. Subway offers a wide variety of fresh, customizable sandwiches that cater (满足) to different tastes and dietary needs (饮食需求).
The WKU Library Information Desk (图书馆咨询台) is on the 3rd floor of SLAC. There, you can inquire (问询) about any information, books, or materials you need.

The Library Study Room is located on the 4th floor of SLAC. It features a 'Harry Potter' style design. You can study here once the library is open.
 

NB: You need to change the elevator (电梯) to get to the 4th–6th floors!

The massage chairs area is on the 5th floor of SLAC. You can rest here if you feel exhausted. If you want to use it, please book through ONCE.


NB: You need to change the elevator (电梯) to get to the 4th–6th floors!

The café (咖啡馆) in GHK has a Starbucks Coffee. You can also study here. It is located on the first floor. Just between us - it is the only Apple Products Experience Center (苹果校园体验中心) on a university campus in all of Wenzhou.
The GHK Library is located on the 2nd floor. Come and study here! You will notice some differences compared to SLAC.
The gardens of GHK are located on the 2nd floor. You can enjoy the beautiful view of the mountains and other buildings on campus.

The public space is located on the 3rd floor of CSMT. You can learn, play, and take a rest here.


Oh, this picture was taken from the 4th floor :)!
The CSMT Library is on the 2nd floor. It now serves as the Graduate Student Lounge for CSMT postgraduates (研究生).

At the printing station, A4 black-and-white prints cost 0.2 RMB (single-sided) or 0.4 RMB (double-sided). Color prints are 1 RMB (single-sided) or 2 RMB (double-sided).

Free printing is available for certain documents, such as enrollment certificates (30 copies) and ranking certificates (10 copies).

The graded readers bookshelf is on the same floor as the WKU Library Information Desk. Just go straight, then turn left at the end of the bookshelves.

First, each person on the team has to pick a Graded Reader (分级读物). Then, as a team, find a seat on the 3rd floor and read your books for 10 minutes without using technology. One person should set a timer for 10 minutes. Do not forget to take a picture of your team reading.
